name: use-after-free
title: Do not use ownership after free
lesson: After a pointer's allocation has been freed, the pointer no longer names live storage.
fix_goal: Stop using pointers after ownership has been released.
fix_steps: Move any needed reads before the free, or keep the storage live until the last use.
Set the pointer to NULL after free if it remains in scope.
Reject later use when the pointer no longer owns live storage.
